text: The rail fence writes the message in a zigzag across a few lines and reads each line in turn; the redefence reads the lines in a chosen order. Both are classic hand transpositions.
After the move a repeating secret word on the table must give the copper's letters where the known letters landed; two known letters in one slot of the word must agree.
12,784 settings of 2 to 6 rails, every start and rail order, keys of 1 to 26 before or after: nothing below period 22, and every count inside the range of ten scrambled coppers.
